Defense in depth: a phished clinic workstation
An attacker on a clinic PC must still get past:
1 · Network Firewall inspects clinic → AWS traffic on the Transit Gateway
2 · NACL at the data-tier boundary allows only app + integration subnets
3 · Security groups reference tiers: only app + integration SGs reach Aurora :5432
4 · Encryption with KMS keys the attacker's identity cannot use (ABAC on DataClass=restricted)
Meanwhile: GuardDuty + MDR detect, EventBridge quarantines the instance, CloudTrail data events prove what was touched.
Egress: even with a foothold, outbound traffic only reaches allow-listed domains, so PHI can't be sent to an attacker's server.
Blast radius: each account is a hard boundary. A compromised Dev account can't reach Prod: separate IAM, SCPs, and TGW route tables.
